apps.name: Unity Demo Probe
apps.summary: Unity Demos is a measurement tool for Brewser, not a game. It loads a curated matrix of real Unity WebGL debug builds (spanning Unity 2021 LTS through Unity 6) one at a time and records exactly how far each one gets before it stalls, crashes, or completes. Pick a build from the table and press A to launch it. The harness watches the whole load and writes a per-run NDJSON log to…
